import json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/tmp/drvgo-ci-bootstrap-tests');out=Path('/tmp/drvgo-bootstrap-validation');out.mkdir()
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('GO','CGO_'))}
env.update(GOENV='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOPROXY='off',GOSUMDB='off',CGO_ENABLED='0',GOMAXPROCS='4',GOFLAGS='',GOCACHE=str(out/'go-cache'))
go='/nix/store/xrgn6m0c5vbz06467q06zdwnk6qqdl7z-go-1.26.5/bin/go'
env['PATH']=str(Path(go).parent)+':'+os.environ['PATH']
report=dict(revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),checks=[])
for args in [['test','-count=1','./...'],['vet','./...']]:
 with (out/(args[0]+'.log')).open('w') as log:subprocess.run([go,*args],cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 report['checks'].append(dict(command=[go,*args],status='passed'));print('passed',args,flush=True)
source=out/'flags.go';source.write_text('package main\nimport ("os"; "github.com/ryantm/drvgo/internal/testutil")\nfunc main(){os.Stdout.WriteString(testutil.GoFlags())}\n')
overlay=out/'overlay.json';overlay.write_text(json.dumps({'Replace':{str(repo/'cmd/drvgo/main.go'):str(source)}}))
for label,compiler in [
 ('1.26.5',go),
 ('1.25','/nix/store/sxjb8c3j87mw5b7n4ghb6wbqyv2mspsx-go-libnix-toolchain/bin/go'),
 ('1.26.6','/nix/store/dkw8v2g9qy0xflsag291j7s5hgc29ybs-go-libnix-toolchain/bin/go')]:
 version=subprocess.check_output([compiler,'version'],text=True).strip()
 for trimmed in [False,True]:
  binary=out/f'flags-{label}-{trimmed}'
  command=[compiler,'build','-p','2','-overlay',str(overlay),'-buildvcs=false','-o',str(binary),*(['-trimpath'] if trimmed else []),'./cmd/drvgo']
  with (out/f'flags-{label}-{trimmed}.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(command,cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  for ambient in ['', '-trimpath', '-trimpath=false -mod=vendor -gcflags=invalid']:
   actual=subprocess.check_output([str(binary)],env={**env,'GOFLAGS':ambient},text=True)
   assert actual==('-trimpath' if trimmed else ''),(version,trimmed,ambient,actual)
  report['checks'].append(dict(version=version,command=command,status='passed',trimmed=trimmed,ambient_settings_ignored=True));print('passed metadata',version,trimmed,flush=True)
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

import hashlib,json,os,shutil,statistics,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-probe');out.mkdir()
repo=Path('/tmp/drvgo-ci-script-rendering')
go='/nix/store/xrgn6m0c5vbz06467q06zdwnk6qqdl7z-go-1.26.5/bin/go'
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('GO','CGO_'))}
env.update(GOENV='off',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOPROXY='off',GOSUMDB='off',CGO_ENABLED='1',GOMAXPROCS='2',HOME=str(out/'home'),GOPATH=str(out/'gopath'))
(out/'home').mkdir()
env['GOCACHE']=str(out/'list-cache')
packages=sorted(set(subprocess.check_output([go,'list','-deps','-f','{{if .Standard}}{{.ImportPath}}{{end}}','./cmd/drvgo'],cwd=repo,env=env,text=True).split()))
base=[go,'build','-p','2','-trimpath','-buildvcs=false','-ldflags=-s -w']
report=dict(scope='Prototype cold CLI compilation with warm SDK/source filesystem caches, using empty Go caches versus copies of a separately compiled standard-library-only cache. Copy time included. No Nix sandbox/cache transport measurement yet.',repo=str(repo),revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),packages=packages,environment={k:v for k,v in env.items() if k.startswith(('GO','CGO_'))},seed_command=base+packages,records=[])
print('Standard packages',len(packages),flush=True)
env['GOCACHE']=str(out/'seed')
with (out/'seed.log').open('w') as log:
 start=time.monotonic();subprocess.run(base+packages,cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True);report['seed_build_seconds']=time.monotonic()-start
files=[p for p in (out/'seed').rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
report['seed_files']=len(files);report['seed_bytes']=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files)
print('Seed',report['seed_build_seconds'],report['seed_files'],report['seed_bytes'],flush=True)
for trial in range(4):
 for label in (['cold','seeded'] if trial%2==0 else ['seeded','cold']):
  cache=out/f'cache-{label}-{trial}';binary=out/f'drvgo-{label}-{trial}';env['GOCACHE']=str(cache)
  start=time.monotonic()
  if label=='seeded':shutil.copytree(out/'seed',cache)
  else:cache.mkdir()
  copied=time.monotonic()
  command=base+['-o',str(binary),'./cmd/drvgo']
  with (out/f'{label}-{trial}.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run(command,cwd=repo,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
  end=time.monotonic()
  r=dict(label=label,trial=trial,warmup=trial==0,copy_seconds=copied-start,build_seconds=end-copied,total=end-start,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),command=command)
  report['records'].append(r);print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
  (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert len({r['binary_sha256'] for r in report['records']})==1
report['medians']={label:{phase:statistics.median(r[phase] for r in report['records'] if r['label']==label and not r['warmup']) for phase in ['copy_seconds','build_seconds','total']} for label in ['cold','seeded']}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('MEDIANS',json.dumps(report['medians']),flush=True)

import hashlib,json,statistics,subprocess,time,uuid
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-nix-benchmark');out.mkdir()
flags=['--cores','2','--max-jobs','4','--option','sandbox','true','--option','sandbox-fallback','false','--option','allow-import-from-derivation','false','--option','substituters','','--option','always-allow-substitutes','false']
report=dict(scope='Strict Nix CLI builds with fresh derivations, including buildGoModule checks; warm SDK and standard-library cache store output, no substituters. Evaluation, realization, and complete output NAR hashes recorded. Standard-library producer and transfer costs excluded here and must be measured separately.',flags=flags,prototype=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-prototype.nix').read_text(),seed=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-nix-seed.out').read_text().strip(),records=[])
nonce=uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
for trial in range(4):
 for label in (['cold','seeded'] if trial%2==0 else ['seeded','cold']):
  name=f'drvgo-bootstrap-{nonce}-{label}-{trial}'
  instantiate=['nix-instantiate','/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-prototype.nix','-A','package','--argstr','name',name,'--arg','seeded','true' if label=='seeded' else 'false',*flags]
  with (out/f'{label}-{trial}.log').open('w') as log:
   start=time.monotonic();drv=subprocess.check_output(instantiate,stderr=log,text=True).strip();evaluated=time.monotonic()
   output=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store','--realise',drv,*flags],stderr=log,text=True).strip();end=time.monotonic()
  record=dict(label=label,trial=trial,warmup=trial==0,evaluation=evaluated-start,realization=end-evaluated,total=end-start,instantiate=instantiate,derivation=drv,output=output,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256((Path(output)/'bin/drvgo').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),nar_hash=subprocess.check_output(['nix-hash','--type','sha256',output],text=True).strip(),references=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store','--query','--references',output],text=True).splitlines())
  report['records'].append(record);print(label,trial,round(record['total'],3),record['nar_hash'],flush=True)
  (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert len({r['nar_hash'] for r in report['records']})==1
assert len({r['binary_sha256'] for r in report['records']})==1
assert len({json.dumps(r['references']) for r in report['records']})==1
report['medians']={label:{phase:statistics.median(r[phase] for r in report['records'] if r['label']==label and not r['warmup']) for phase in ['evaluation','realization','total']} for label in ['cold','seeded']}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('MEDIANS',json.dumps(report['medians']),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-checks-benchmark');out.mkdir()
flags=['--cores','2','--max-jobs','4','--option','sandbox','true','--option','sandbox-fallback','false','--option','allow-import-from-derivation','false','--option','substituters','','--option','always-allow-substitutes','false']
seed=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-checks-seed.out').read_text().strip()
seed_hash=subprocess.check_output(['nix-hash','--type','sha256',seed],text=True).strip()
report=dict(scope='Strict Nix CLI builds including checks: empty Go cache; copied prebuilt standard-library/test cache; or freshly built cache producer plus CLI. Warm SDK and filesystem caches, no substitutions. Three rotating trials plus warmups. No network transfer timing.',flags=flags,prototype=Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-checks.nix').read_text(),packages=json.loads(Path('/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-roots.json').read_text()),seed=seed,seed_nar_hash=seed_hash,records=[])
nonce=uuid.uuid4().hex[:12];labels=['cold','seeded','fresh-seed']
for trial in range(4):
 order=labels[trial%3:]+labels[:trial%3]
 for label in order:
  name=f'drvgo-bootstrap-checks-{nonce}-{label}-{trial}'
  cache_name=f'drvgo-stdlib-repeat-{nonce}-{trial}' if label=='fresh-seed' else 'drvgo-stdlib-checks-cache-prototype'
  args=['--argstr','name',name,'--argstr','cacheName',cache_name,'--arg','seeded','false' if label=='cold' else 'true']
  instantiate=['nix-instantiate','/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-checks.nix','-A','package',*args,*flags]
  with (out/f'{label}-{trial}.log').open('w') as log:
   start=time.monotonic();drv=subprocess.check_output(instantiate,stderr=log,text=True).strip();evaluated=time.monotonic()
   output=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store','--realise',drv,*flags],stderr=log,text=True).strip();end=time.monotonic()
  r=dict(label=label,trial=trial,warmup=trial==0,evaluation=evaluated-start,realization=end-evaluated,total=end-start,instantiate=instantiate,derivation=drv,output=output,binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256((Path(output)/'bin/drvgo').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),nar_hash=subprocess.check_output(['nix-hash','--type','sha256',output],text=True).strip(),references=subprocess.check_output(['nix-store','--query','--references',output],text=True).splitlines())
  if label=='fresh-seed':
   cache=subprocess.check_output(['nix-instantiate','/tmp/drvgo-stdlib-cache-checks.nix','-A','cache.outPath','--eval','--raw',*args,*flags],text=True).strip()
   r['cache']=cache;r['cache_nar_hash']=subprocess.check_output(['nix-hash','--type','sha256',cache],text=True).strip()
   assert r['cache_nar_hash']==seed_hash,(cache,r['cache_nar_hash'],seed_hash)
  report['records'].append(r);print(label,trial,round(r['total'],3),r['nar_hash'],flush=True)
  (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
assert len({r['nar_hash'] for r in report['records']})==1
assert len({r['binary_sha256'] for r in report['records']})==1
assert len({json.dumps(r['references']) for r in report['records']})==1
report['medians']={label:{phase:statistics.median(r[phase] for r in report['records'] if r['label']==label and not r['warmup']) for phase in ['evaluation','realization','total']} for label in labels}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print('MEDIANS',json.dumps(report['medians']),flush=True)
